description.value: Le Pho is a homestyle Vietnamese restaurant in the Oak Bay neighbourhood of Victoria, inspired by Lam family recipes and made with fresh local ingredients. The menu spans pho-style vermicelli bowls, curries, salads, and starters, with strong vegetarian and gluten-free representation throughout. Cyclists can order for pickup or have food delivered, making it a practical stop on the Fort Street corridor.
